dedupe.method: Normalized exact native URL plus canonical platform post ID, video ID, commit SHA, or pull-request ID.

x.notes: All recorded official X handle/status paths were queried for the post-2026-07-15 gap after prior source-hunt coverage through July 15; public native-path search returned no exact post candidate and anonymous syndication was rate-limited.

linkedin.notes: All recorded official company/founder post-path handles were queried for the post-2026-07-15 gap after prior source-hunt coverage through July 15; no exact official-author native post candidate survived.

youtube.notes: Resolved every official handle to its native channel ID, read the official channel Atom feed, and verified candidates on native watch pages.

reddit.notes: Grouped company/founder native-result searches produced no exact recent official-author candidate; the unauthenticated Reddit JSON and RSS endpoints returned access blocks.

instagram.notes: All recorded official handles were queried for the post-2026-07-15 gap; no exact native post candidate was indexed. Direct public profile metadata failed with Instagram's deleted-schema response, so no unverified or profile-only row was accepted.

github.notes: Checked native public account feeds and commit feeds for every GitHub repository already tied to A16ZSR006 in canonical or source-hunt artifacts; verified final rows on native commit or pull-request pages.

product_hunt.notes: Checked the recorded Quanto, SUN, and Taxnova product paths and recent native launch search; no net-new launch or maker-comment row qualified.

hacker_news.notes: Queried the public HN Algolia story/comment index for all 59 company names from 2026-07-09 onward; no exact matching native item was returned.

first_party_web.notes: Amdahl's July 10 first-party article was net-new and attributable but had no visible engagement metric, so it was rejected under the strict rule. August's homepage did not fetch; no other first-party feed exposed a qualifying recent item.
